_comment: Upstox equity-delivery fee model + fee-aware position sizing thresholds. Edit rates here if Upstox changes its schedule — no code changes needed.

sizing._comment: A proposed trade is rejected (qty -> 0) rather than downsized if estimated round-trip fee exceeds this fraction of the trade's notional value.

rebalance._comment: Controls autopilot/active_manager.py proactive rebalancing (was: hardcoded in ActiveConfig).
